title: Tighten Tensor stored-factor rounding from (n+6)/4 to (n+2)/4
body:
## Summary

Scoped written mathematical proof with exact finite corroboration. The unchanged five-stage Tensor arithmetic admits a smaller stored-factor rounding allowance:

```diff
- sqrt(2) [2^-p + 2^(2sigma-P) (n+6)/4]
+ sqrt(2) [2^-p + 2^(2sigma-P) (n+2)/4]
```

Consecutive signed truncations compose exactly. Retaining that dependence gives the new joint-residual identity and the improvement above. The free-integer scalar tail also has exact maximum `2^-p (1-gcd(C,D)/D)`, where `D=2^(2P-p-2sigma)`. Sharpness is claimed for that tail, not the whole row. A declared one-source sufficient-rounding test saves one work bit; no production precision policy is installed.

The new result and verifier were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Hiroki KUMAZAKI/kumagi's #5295 at `351975ee703ec5aa1b18f70f73700d434026199a` for the five-residual interface and coarse bound, JoyboyBrian's #5056 for the norm invariant, Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml for the physical expansion, Dugongue and the retained Gaussian/coefficient/native lineage. Those results are cited mathematical inputs, not rechecked as the contribution. The quotient and gcd identities are classical; the new step is their sharper joint-residual application here.

## Evidence

- Before: #5295's independent residual budget has work-grid coefficient `(n+6)/4`. After: the written joint-residual proof gives `(n+2)/4` for every row under the declared exact stored-factor arithmetic interface.
- Exact finite verification passes 262,208 signed composition cases; 304 tail systems with 224,272 signed inputs and attained maxima; 164,700 scalar rows; 14,406 complex rows; and eighteen rejection/boundary/omission controls. The scalar domain includes 73,200 zero-extraction-shift rows. Opposite-input fixtures are not asserted to have weighted cancellation in every case.
- CPython 3.12.15, macOS arm64, standard library only. Both registered warning-strict ordinary and optimized commands pass. The timed direct commands took 4.07 seconds ordinary and 3.97 seconds optimized, well below their individual 120-second limits. These are check durations, not speedup claims.
- Metadata/source pins, committed bytes/modes and full source-history preflight pass at `471f3ec22c77bc37679e2e4ca29d881dfd56ad9f`. The official six-file committed export passes integrity checking. Read-only, Git-free optimized replay with an empty executable search path passes without changing exported hashes; source drift is rejected. Receipts are generated by the verifier and bind all five package files plus the pinned proof input.

From the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/tensor-joint-rounding/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/tensor-joint-rounding/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/tensor-joint-rounding
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/tensor-joint-rounding --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected markers are `PASS_TENSOR_JOINT_ROUNDING`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. Any CPython 3.12 interpreter can replace the local path. The package README contains the complete proof, finite domains, source attribution and export contract.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal claim rests on the written arithmetic proof. Finite checks corroborate it; independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. This bounds error against the stored-factor row. Coefficient enclosure, production tails, producer admission, operand widths, physical Tensor execution, chirp/compression, complete Fourier/CRT accuracy, native/compiler/tape costs and the five selected framework assumptions are separate. None of their full replays, Lean, Docker or the selected scientific cold replay ran. No whole-row sharpness, physical saving, supplier admission, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Open next questions

1. Can one complete admitted producer lower work precision while preserving all coefficient, tail and width gates? Start with its full precision conjunction; this local allowance alone is insufficient.
2. What is the sharp whole-row defect for one stored page? Start with reachable post-B residues, which earlier truncations and signed convolution couple.
